facts.architecture: Qwen3.8-27B retrained by UkisAI to think less (Swift 1.5): 64 layers, of which 16 attend fully (the rest are linear-attention layers with a recurrent state); an MTP head

template.source: Qwen's reference chat template, as design 0012 §4.2 reads it: earlier thinking rendered only after the last user message, tool calls as XML; the template inside the model file is still to read (design 0012 §10)

files.notes: IQ3_S with ISTA-DASLab's GSQ-RCO allocation, refined by UkisAI, the MTP head embedded; the file of the video 'How I Got Frontier Performance on 16GB VRAM' (decision 0068). Under the Swift Open License v1.0, not Apache: read it before any commercial use. No vision projector

kvmem-llamacpp.source: Qwen3.8-27B's sizes: its file holds the same 866 tensors at the same types and shapes (compared with gguf's reader on 2026-10-18; the files differ by 64 bytes of metadata); layers: the 66 KVMem's log offloads for Qwen3.8-27B's file, whose layers are the same ("offloaded 66/66 layers to GPU", 2026-10-12), which the estimate splits the weights by when fewer are on the GPU
